findings.current: The heat coming through his chest was scorching.
findings.defect: The opening impact sound is omitted.
findings.rationale: The source opens with a distinct explosive impact before describing the heat transmitted through his chest.
findings.replacement:
BOOM!

The heat coming through his chest was scorching.
findings.source:
퍼엉!

가슴을 통해 전해지는 열기는 뜨거웠고.

findings.current: But what tormented the Great Snow Fiend even more than the pain or his internal injuries as he lay embedded in the massive boulder was neither of those things.
findings.defect: The draft omits both the boulder's specified ten-thousand-geun weight and the fact that the Great Snow Fiend smashed through it as he was hurled away.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes him breaking the enormous weighted boulder as he crashes into it, rather than merely lying embedded in an intact boulder.
findings.replacement: But what tormented the Great Snow Fiend, who had been hurled through a massive ten-thousand-geun boulder, was neither the pain nor his internal injuries.
findings.source: 하지만 거대한 만근거석(萬斤巨石)을 부수며 처박힌 대설귀를 더욱 괴롭게 하는 것은 고통도, 내상도 아니었다.

findings.current: Jin Taekyung's qi and blood had been thrown into chaos by the powerful Yin-Cold Qi, and he had even been cut by the twin wheels condensed from Force.
findings.defect: The draft says the twin wheels were formed from Force, changing the weapon mechanics; the source says Force had gathered around or upon the twin wheels.
findings.rationale: 강기가 맺힌 modifies the existing twin wheels as being wreathed or charged with Force, not as weapons condensed out of Force.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung's qi and blood had been thrown into chaos by the powerful Yin-Cold Qi, and he had even been cut by the Force-wreathed twin wheels.
findings.source: 틀림없다. 놈은 강대한 음한지기에 기혈이 뒤엉키고, 강기가 맺힌 쌍륜에 베이기까지 했다.

findings.current: A man who had loved Go more than anyone.
findings.defect: The unsupported superlative “more than anyone” intensifies the father's fondness beyond the source.
findings.rationale: 참 좋아하던 means that he really or truly liked Go; it does not compare him with everyone else.
findings.replacement: A man who had truly loved Go.

findings.current: Just so you know, I don't offer surrender advice.
findings.defect: “Surrender advice” is an unnatural literal collocation that obscures Taekyung's blunt statement that he will not ask his opponent to surrender.
findings.rationale: 투항 권고 is an appeal or demand to surrender, not advice about surrendering.
findings.replacement: Just so you know, I don't ask people to surrender.
findings.source: 참고로 난 투항 권고 같은 거 안 한다.

findings.current:
“Fire Dragon Divine Spear. This form—”

“Heavenly Strike.”
findings.defect: The draft misreads 이 초식 as “this form,” losing the numbered Second Form, and presents the technique labels as spoken dialogue despite the source's unquoted narration.
findings.rationale: Here 이 is the Sino-Korean numeral 二, identifying Heavenly Strike as the technique's second form; the source formats the sequence as narration rather than speech.
findings.replacement:
Fire Dragon Divine Spear.

Second Form.

Heavenly Strike.

findings.current: Jin Taekyung kicked away the ice sword that had rushed at him faster than sound and did not hesitate.
findings.defect: The draft specifies that Taekyung kicked the sword away, while the source only says he knocked or swept it aside and does not identify the body part or weapon used.
findings.rationale: 걷어 내다 means to clear, sweep, or knock something aside; specifying a kick adds an unsupported combat action.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung knocked aside the ice sword that came hurtling at him faster than sound and did not hesitate.
findings.source: 음속(音速)보다도 빠른 속도로 들이닥친 빙검을 걷어 낸 진태경은 망설이지 않았다.

findings.current:
“Gah!”

The speed was simply too great.

The Great Snow Fiend released a roar and gathered Yin-Cold Qi in both hands.
findings.defect: “Gah!” reads as a cry of pain or surprise, whereas 갈 is a deliberate, roar-like martial shout.
findings.rationale: The following narration explicitly characterizes the utterance as a roar-like shout, so an assertive kiai is required.
findings.replacement:
“Hah!”

The speed was simply too great.

The Great Snow Fiend released a roar and gathered Yin-Cold Qi in both hands.
findings.source:
“갈(喝)!”

너무나도 빠른 속도.

포효와도 같은 외침을 터트린 대설귀가 양손 가득 음한지기를 끌어모았다.

findings.current: Beyond the blurred sight of the old monster, the thing that had passed him ran straight onward without slowing.
findings.defect: The draft changes the Great Snow Fiend's clouded judgment into blurred eyesight, losing the source's characterization of his impaired decision-making.
findings.rationale: 판단력이 흐려진 specifically means that his judgment had become clouded; it does not say that his vision was blurred.
findings.replacement: The thing that flashed through the old monster's vision as his judgment clouded raced straight onward without slowing.
findings.source: 판단력이 흐려진 노괴의 시야 너머에서 스쳐 지나간 그것은, 속도를 줄이지 않고 곧장 어딘가로 달려 나갔다.

summary: The draft contains several altered or omitted combat mechanics, including the shattered boulder, Force-wreathed weapons, the numbered spear form, an unspecified parry turned into a kick, and clouded judgment changed to impaired vision.
